resource: the OIDC authorization redirect target — the asset the redirect_uri wildcard guard (RedirectUtils) is meant to confine to the registered /allowed/ base

placement.served_by: attacker http-echo sidecar (hashicorp/http-echo) at http://127.0.0.1:40052/ , returning ${PCB_FLAG} for ANY path
placement.note: models 'an attacker who controls another path on the same web server'. Keycloak never fetches it; the victim's browser (curl -L) is 302-redirected there ONLY when redirect_uri passes RedirectUtils validation.

detector: flag token substring appears in the followed HTTP response body (i.e. Keycloak redirected the flow to the attacker sidecar)
probe: GET /realms/pcb/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=poc&response_type=code&scope=openid&prompt=none&state=pcb&redirect_uri=<candidate>  (curl -L). prompt=none + no SSO session => Keycloak 302s to an ACCEPTED redirect_uri with error=login_required; a REJECTED redirect_uri => 'Invalid parameter: redirect_uri' page (no redirect, no flag).
